# Who Can Check What AI Assistants Say About Your Company

Good news: **anyone** — including you, as the business owner — can check this. There's no special regulatory body or exclusive authority required. This emerging practice is called "AI visibility monitoring," "AI brand monitoring," or "AI reputation management," and it's accessible through a few different paths:

## 1. You Can Do It Yourself (Manual Checking)
You can simply prompt AI engines to summarize customer opinions about your business directly. Just ask ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, or Copilot things like "What do you know about [Your Company]?" or "How does [Your Company] compare to [Competitor]?" However, one limitation: because conversations are private, you cannot see what ChatGPT tells individual users about your brand, only what it tells you when you ask.

## 2. Dedicated AI Monitoring Tools/Software
Anyone (business owners, marketers, agencies) can subscribe to specialized platforms built exactly for this. AI visibility monitoring software tracks how your brand shows up when someone asks ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, or Google Gemini a question, and tells you if your brand gets mentioned and whether the information is accurate. Popular tools mentioned in current guides include:
- **Otterly.ai** – one of the first dedicated AI monitoring tools that tracks your brand mentions across ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity, and provides alerts when AI responses change
- **Profound** – monitors AI recommendations and provides competitive analysis
- **Semrush Enterprise AIO** – focuses on maximizing brand visibility within AI-driven search environments and provides AI Visibility Tracking to monitor mentions, citations and sentiment globally
- **Ahrefs Brand Radar**, **Chatbeat**, **Waikay**, **PageCrawl**, and others also offer similar tracking across multiple AI platforms.

## 3. Marketing/SEO Agencies
Monitoring your business presence in AI-generated results usually means using a combination of AI visibility tools, specialist SEO agencies, and proactive reporting platforms. If you don't want to manage it yourself, digital marketing or "AI reputation management" agencies now offer this as a service.

## 4. IT/Security Teams (Different Context)
Note: if your question is actually about **employees using AI tools at work** (rather than what AI says publicly about your company), that's a separate concern handled internally — tools like CurrentWare track employee AI usage by monitoring the applications and websites your team accesses, including popular AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Copilot, letting IT/security staff see who's using what.

## Why This Matters
ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Claude are making recommendations about your business to millions of people, and you probably have no idea what they are saying — AI can recommend you accurately, recommend you with wrong information, recommend your competitor instead, or not know you exist at all.

**Bottom line:** There's no gatekeeper limiting who can check this — it's an open practice available to any business owner, marketer, or agency you hire, using either free manual queries or paid monitoring platforms.
